svg.text: BEN Engine — Power One-Line — BEN 500 (192 kW IT, 10 racks, N+1) — Schreiber AI — IFC Rev B · 2026-11-08
AI inference edge preset · 480 V 3ph · service 400 A · total 212.3 kW (223.5 kVA) · UPS 2×232 kVA · battery 35.6 kWh for 10 min · PUE est. 1.136
480 V 3ph from the site transformer / pad
main breaker 400 A frame · SPD TYPE 1 on the line side
feeder 600 kcmil Cu (or 2×#3/0) + EGC #3 in conduit · ground ring + rods
400 A, 3-pole, open transition, 10 s start delay
weekly generator exercise · Modbus to gateway
online double-conversion · Li-ion 35.6 kWh / 10 min · maintenance bypass
input / output breakers 350 A each · SNMP + Modbus to gateway
K-13 rated · in the power section · X0 bonded here only
each rack: two PDUs (A and B paths) · 80 A branch · #3 Cu
locking receptacle · PDU per-outlet metering over SNMP
generator-ready = ATS + pad + conduit · Modbus status
fed AFTER the ATS, BEFORE the UPS (generator-backed)
own breaker + disconnect at each unit · SPD type 2
20 A circuits · GFCI receptacles · ATS side, not UPS
gateway · PoE switch · nodes · releasing-panel charger
from the IT panel, own breaker, labelled CONTROLS
EPO stations at each door → series NC loop → shunt trips:
UPS output breaker · IT panel main · mechanical panel main
node EPO MONITOR reads an AUX contact only · NFPA 70 645.10 / 645.11
TYPE 1 SPD at the service entrance (line side of main), 100 kA/phase
TYPE 2 SPD in the IT panel and the mechanical panel, 50 kA/phase
SPD status contacts → BEN node spare DI · annunciated on the dashboard
Container shell = bonding grid: four corner castings bonded #2/0 Cu to the ground ring
Ground ring #2 bare Cu · 2 rods 8 ft Cu-clad ≥ 6 ft apart · ≤ 5 Ω target (measure, record)
Equipment grounding conductors per NEC 250.122 (sizes on the feeders)
Isolated ground bar in the IT panel · rack rails bonded #6 Cu
Separately derived system at the transformer: X0 → GEC at the transformer only
Lightning: Class II air terminals on 20 / 40 ft containers in high-keraunic sites (option)
Sizes come from ben_engine.config — change the config, not this drawing
Service 400 A @ 480 V 3ph: calc 336 A incl. 125 % continuous
UPS carries IT only: 2 × 232 kVA, 15 % headroom, N+1
Battery 35.6 kWh Li-ion for 10 min at full IT (90 % DoD)
Rack branch 80 A @ 208 V 3φ for 19.2 kW/rack
Selective coordination main > ATS > UPS > panel > branch — EOR verifies TCC
Arc-flash labels at every panel per NFPA 70E after final equipment selection
